newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Airborne Freight estimate up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Airborne Freight estimate up.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said on Tuesday it raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Airborne Freight Corp to $2.15 a share from $1.85 and its 1998 outlook to $2.40 from $2.15 as the company is expected to benefit from price increases by two competitors.
-- A favorable shift in the yield/cost equation stemming from the price increases by the competition is helping Airborne Freight in addition to the shipping company's healthy shipment growth.
-- Gruntal said Airborne Freight's shares have gained 65 percent since November 1, and Gruntal believes there is another 13 percent in the shares to $38 each.
-- Airborne Freight's stock closed up 1-3/4 Tuesday at 35-3/8.
